|game_text=[Pilot] 3. Cards with "Han" in title are destiny +3. May use 1 Force to cancel [[Boba Fett (Cloud City) (V) (Virtual Block 2){{!}}Boba Fett]]'s or Jabba's game text for remainder of turn. If opponent just initiated battle here, may use 1 Force to take the first weapons segment action.
|errata_history=This is the original printed text (version 1 of 4). The image here is the release-sheet slip that prints it. The current text is [[Han Solo (V) (Virtual Block 1) (Errata 3)]] (PC-E3): the Master List of 27 April 2013. The PC card image ([[Han Solo (V) (Virtual Block 1) (Errata 2)]], PC-E2) and the Master List both print this text again word for word.
* '''Original''' (this page): text as given in the Virtual Block 1 release sheet (official text as of 7 December 2009): “[Pilot] 3. Cards with “Han” in title are destiny +3. May use 1 Force to cancel Boba Fett’s or Jabba’s game text for remainder of turn. If opponent just initiated battle here, may use 1 Force to take the first weapons segment action.”.<ref name="sheet-VirtualBlock1">[https://res.starwarsccg.org/legacyblocks/VirtualBlock1.pdf#page=7 Virtual Block 1 release sheet] ("Official text as of 7 December 2009"), page 7, slip 99E. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261020181626/https://res.starwarsccg.org/legacyblocks/VirtualBlock1.pdf#page=7 Internet Archive]</ref> Full text: “[Pilot] 3. Cards with "Han" in title are destiny +3. May use 1 Force to cancel Boba Fett's or Jabba's game text for remainder of turn. If opponent just initiated battle here, may use 1 Force to take the first weapons segment action.” Document: the release-sheet slip ([[:File:VB1-99E-Han_Solo.png]]) prints slip number “99E” bottom right.
* '''PC-E1''' ([[Han Solo (V) (Virtual Block 1) (Errata)]]): the PC website card list (shown there by 21 July 2012, the earliest archived capture with text, and still on 11 January 2013) changed “Boba Fett’s or Jabba’s game text” to “Boba Fett or Jabba's game text” (“Adds 3 to power of anything he pilots” is the card list's spelling of the pilot icon, not a change). PC-E1 text: “Adds 3 to power of anything he pilots. Cards with 'Han' in title are destiny +3. May use 1 Force to cancel Boba Fett or Jabba's game text for remainder of turn. If opponent just initiated battle here, may use 1 Force to take the first weapons segment action.”<ref name="cl-1210_101">Players Committee website card list (VBlock1Type), as captured [https://web.archive.org/web/20120721064706/http://www.starwarsccg.org:80/cardlists/VBlock1Type.html 2012-07-21] and [https://web.archive.org/web/20130111142851/http://www.starwarsccg.org/cardlists/VBlock1Type.html 2013-01-11] (Internet Archive)</ref> The card list drops icons; the icons here are those of the printed slip. Card-list differences are versions (wiki versions ruling, 8 November 2026). The card-list entry ends with the Players Committee's own label “(Errata Text - September 9th, 2009)”, the date of the errata that the “E” slip also shows; the wording of the entry differs from the slip as described. The PC website card list was generated from the Players Committee's Holotable card data (research R7, 11 November 2026), so its wording follows that data; it is listed as a version because the PC published it.
* '''PC-E2''' ([[Han Solo (V) (Virtual Block 1) (Errata 2)]]): Players Committee card image ([[:File:VB1-L-hansolo-pre.gif]]), on the PC website by 25 February 2013 (server upload date)<ref name="pcimg-Virtual1-Light">Players Committee card image, file <code>cardlists/images/starwars/Virtual1-Light/large/hansolo.gif</code>; the directory listing of this folder (Virtual1-Light) was not captured; the captured Legacy folders (Virtual2, Virtual4, Virtual5, Virtual6, Virtual7) all carry 25-Feb-2013 11:33/11:34, the date the PC rebuilt its image set (research R6, 11 November 2026: these are bulk upload dates, and an image may have been made earlier). Today's copy: https://res.starwarsccg.org/cards/legacy/VirtualBlock1-Light/large/hansolo.gif</ref>: “[Pilot] 3. Cards with "Han" in title are destiny +3. May use 1 Force to cancel Boba Fett's or Jabba's game text for remainder of turn. If opponent just initiated battle here, may use 1 Force to take the first weapons segment action.” '''What changed:''' the PC card image prints the original release-sheet text of 7 December 2009 again, word for word, after the PC website card list (PC-E1) had published a different text. It is listed as its own version, placed at its upload date (Bill's rulings of 11 November 2026: a PC card image is its own version, placed at its date (here its server upload date), even when its words repeat an earlier version; whatever was published last is current). The date is only the folder's bulk upload date: the image may have been made earlier, so its place in the order is uncertain, but the versioning order follows the upload date. Document: the PC card image is a whole card (art, title bar, lore, icons, frame and the Virtual Block 1 set mark) and prints the number “99E” bottom right, as the release-sheet slip does.
* '''PC-E3''' ([[Han Solo (V) (Virtual Block 1) (Errata 3)]]): Players Committee Virtual Cards Master List (Light Side p. 8), official text as of 27 April 2013<ref name="ml-ls">[[Media:Virtual_Legacy_Final_Master_LS.pdf|Players Committee Virtual Cards Master List (Light Side)]], cover "official text as of April 27, 2013" (PDF built February 2014). Original: http://www.starwarsccg.org/Resources/MasterLS.pdf#page=8, page 8. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20170705013057/http://www.starwarsccg.org/Resources/MasterLS.pdf#page=8 Internet Archive]</ref>: “[Pilot] 3. Cards with "Han" in title are destiny +3. May use 1 Force to cancel Boba Fett's or Jabba's game text for remainder of turn. If opponent just initiated battle here, may use 1 Force to take the first weapons segment action.” '''What changed:''' the Master List prints the original release-sheet text of 7 December 2009 again, word for word. It is the last publication, so it is the current text; it is listed as its own version because it was published (Bill's rulings of 11 November 2026: every publication is a version, even one that repeats an earlier text word for word; whatever was published last is current). The image on its page is the Master List slip ([[:File:VL-history-1210-101-master.png]]). Document: the Master List slip prints no slip number; it prints the errata mark “E” bottom right.
